name: Prometheus MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to execute PromQL queries and discover metrics within AWS Managed Prometheus (AMP) using SigV4 authentication. It provides tools for instant and range queries, label management, and metric discovery in secure, VPC-isolated environments.
